children: Galaxy has added $100 million of sUSDS to its corporate treasury and approved the token as eligible collateral across its institutional trading business, which serves more than 1,600 counterparties and carries a $1.4 billion average loan book. Collateralized positions continue accruing the Sky Savings Rate.

The approval creates a direct demand channel for sUSDS. Institutional borrowers can now post the token as collateral for positions within Galaxy's $1.4 billion loan book while still earning the Sky Savings Rate, so collateral does not sit idle. Galaxy's own $100 million treasury allocation adds a committed holder on top of client usage.

Eligibility alone does not guarantee uptake. Actual demand depends on how many of Galaxy's 1,600-plus counterparties choose sUSDS over existing collateral options, so the change establishes access rather than committed borrowing volume.
Galaxy has added $100M of sUSDS to its corporate treasury and approved it as eligible collateral across its institutional trading business.

title: Sky: Galaxy adds $100M sUSDS to treasury and approves it as institutional collateral - 23 Sep 2026
